stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 2 of "Hunger for Books."

At that moment, standing in the children’s room of the library in Ravenna, Ohio, I realized that if there were still people writing such fresh and fragrant books, then maybe one day I could write some as well.

Which quotation from "The Low-Tech Appeal of Little Free Libraries" expresses a similar sentiment?

options.label: A
options.text: When he saw the people of his community gathering around it like a neighborhood water cooler, exchanging conversation as well as books, he knew he wanted to take his simple idea farther.

options.label: B
options.text: But as DooSun You scrolled through the results, an appealingly anti-tech concept popped up.

options.label: C
options.text: "Little Free Libraries create neighborhood heroes," says Bol.

options.label: D
options.text: When you open the door, serendipity (and your neighbors’ taste) dictates what you’ll find.

visual_elements: Text box containing the sentence from paragraph 2 of 'Hunger for Books.'
Four multiple choice options labeled A to D
